title: Homogeneous Rees coefficients act on ideal-power products
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→Spec A a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], I an ideal of A, J=I O_X [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let G_m=J^m F with inclusion j_m into F, including J^0=O_X [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and B_k=I^k t^k the Rees pieces [def-nagata-rees-algebra], [def-nagata-rees-piece]. There are module-sheaf morphisms μ_(m,k)(b):G_m→G_(m+k) for every m,k≥0 and b∈B_k, such that on every open U and section s of G_m(U), j_(m+k)(μ_(m,k)(b)(s))=f^sharp(coeff_k(b))|_U · j_m(s). No properness or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem idealPowersReesMultiplication {A : Type v} [CommRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (I : Ideal A) (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    let G := fun m ↦ Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F
    let graded := reesGrading I
    ∃ mu : ∀ (m k : ℕ), graded k → (G m ⟶ G (m + k)),
      (∀ (m k : ℕ) (b : graded k) (U : X.Opens) (s : (G m).val.obj (op U)),
        ((Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι (m + k)).2 F).app
          U).hom ((mu m k b).app U s) =
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ U le_top).hom
          (b.val.val.coeff k)) •
        ((Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F).app
          U).hom s)
